component.subject: Intercession
component.title: Prayer of Intercession
component.author: John Bradford
component.source: John Bradford, "A Thanksgiving, being a godly prayer to be read at all times", closing paragraph, in The Writings of John Bradford, vol. 1 (Parker Society, 1848), p. 247.

original.p: Let thy mighty hand and outstretched arm, O Lord, be still our defence, thy mercy and loving-kindness in Jesu Christ thy dear Son our salvation, thy true and holy word our instruction, thy grace and holy Spirit our comfort and consolation unto the end and in the end. Amen.

p.line: Let your mighty hand and outstretched arm, Lord,
your mercy and loving kindness in Jesus Christ your dear Son,
unto the end, and in the end.
